summary_paragraph: Mr. ___ was admitted for a deceased donor liver transplant due to HCV cirrhosis and decompensated liver disease. The transplant was performed successfully on 2179-05-18, and initial recovery was stable with improving liver function and weaning from nitric oxide to sildenafil for portopulmonary hypertension. By postoperative day 8, he acutely decompensated with tachycardia and respiratory failure. Imaging revealed hepatic infarcts and gas-forming abscesses. Blood and tissue cultures confirmed E. coli bacteremia, likely seeded from the donor liver. Despite surgical debridement and intensive support, he developed multi-organ failure and septic shock. After discussion with his health care proxy, care was transitioned to comfort measures, and he expired on 2179-05-26.
